profile.headline: Software Engineer at Capital One - Global Payments Network Technology
profile.summary: A Software Engineer with a strong background in sales and customer success that transforms technical details into business value for clients in English and Spanish.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Utilize AWS to optimize the software development lifecycle and successfully migrate key components of the Discover payments network, enhancing scalability and performance
- Migrate payment dispute systems and leverage Java, Linux, and Openshift
- Contribute to product team deliverables using Java programming technology
- Diagnose opportunities for automation and efficiency in the end to end product delivery cycle
- Leverage Terraform and Ansible to automate cloud infrastructure deployment on AWS for the Discover payment network
- Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Linux · Back-End Web Development · Git · Jenkins · Terraform · Software Infrastructure · Ansible

positions.title: Java Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Learn how to design and enhance automated performance testing frameworks for order books
- Experiment with custom data structures to improve platform performance
- Collaborated with a team to identify opportunities to enhance data operations and potential machine learning applications
- Completed comprehensive courses in options trading, strategies, market structure, cryptocurrencies, risk analysis, and foundational decision theory through the Options Institute
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Git · Python · Software Development · Linux · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: ENGR 102 - Undergraduate Learning Assistant
positions.description:
- Modeled engineering thinking to a diverse group of future engineers via Python programming assignments
- Used communication, time management and organization skills to assist 100 students with technical and group problem solving
- Grade assignments

positions.title: Business Technology Intern
positions.description:
- Learn how the team leverages the current technology stack (Java, Kubernetes, & more).
- Work with automated build and continuous integration systems

positions.title: Technical Engineer
positions.description:
- Troubleshoot, deliver, and document solutions for customers' system issues including software setup, installation and configuration in English and Spanish.

- Work with customers and potential customers on deployment as defined in their license agreement, including server configurations and software installation.

- Contribute to an environment that encourages information sharing, team-based resolution activity, and a focus on resolving customer issues as effectively as possible.

positions.title: Customer Success Product Specialist
positions.description:
- Resolve technical issues for SMB and enterprise customers with Bash Linux scripts.

- Own all technical tasks as part of the implementation and use of Matterport Products for Enterprise and SMB accounts

- Leverage Looker reports to uncover customer insights.

- Partner with Customer Success Managers on special projects to deliver value to customers.

- Support onboarding through delivery of recorded, virtual and on-site training.

- Resolve tickets through Zendesk CRM.

positions.title: Customer Success Engineer (Bilingual)
positions.description:
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues with Bash Linux scripting.

- Provide subject matter expertise to construction, hospitality, and real estate clients in English and Spanish.

- Collaborate with inter-departmental teams to rollout new product offerings.

- Educate customers on how to leverage Matterport’s 3D technology to optimize marketing spend and increase consumer engagement

positions.title: Inside Sales Representative
positions.description:
- Assessed customer needs and identified upsell opportunities within the Matterport product catalog.

- Worked with AEC sales and customer support teams to resolve customer product issues in Latin America.

- Prospected and delivered 40+ product demonstrations on a monthly basis; contributing to Matterport's growth across North and South America.

- Managed the entire sales cycle using SalesForce CRM.

positions.title: Senior Account Executive
positions.description:
- Opened an entirely new industry vertical for the BlueCart platform with large tortilla distributors in California, Texas, & Illinois. 

- Provided technical training and support in Spanish

- Prospected for new BlueCart partnerships throughout the U.S.

positions.title: Direct Sales Account Executive
positions.description:
- Cultivated relationships with C-level clients and actively contributed to the growth of a portfolio worth over $1.25 million.

- Prospected leads for new opportunities from a base of 200+ accounts.

positions.title: Service Coordinator
positions.description:
- Managed all inquiries, service requests, and intern training for the Brighton Park Service Office in English and Spanish.

- Engaged with community organizers and leaders to draft legislation at the City Council.

positions.title: Admissions Counselor
positions.description:
- Successfully increased the Biomedical Sciences Master’s program class size by 150% over the course of four years.

- Traveled to graduate fairs across the country and engaged student organizations to schedule campus visits.

positions.title: T.A.A. Case Manager
positions.description:
- Recruited new clients for the TAA program during site visits and conducted bilingual workshops on basic computer use and resume writing.

- Advised displaced workers on training programs and new career opportunities.

-Traveled to various sites in the Chicagoland area and presented on TAA eligibility for trade-impacted workers.

-Maintained strong partnerships between National Able,  training providers, and the Illinois Department of Employment Services.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant at La Casa Cultural Latina
positions.description:
- Advised students on academic, financial, and career issues.

-Recruited prospective students for undergraduate and graduate programs.

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteer as a foster for dogs rescued from high-kill shelters.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Lambda Theta Phi Latin Fraternity, Inc.
volunteerExperiences.description: Monitored academic performance, counseled, and provided opportunities for undergraduate members to achieve successful academic and career outcomes.

company.name: Lambda Theta Phi Latin Fraternity, Inc.
